name: LIF阈值类5-domain验证PARTIAL-shifted-band
description: v0.4验证leaky_integrate_fire_threshold_class(B3 rank=19, was verified=false): 在5个domain (textbook LIF / Allen Brain Neuropixels real spikes / financial vol-burst proxy / 水力坝-滑坡proxy / sensor cascade)上测量dimensionless ratio R = τ_relax / T_event。结果: ratios=[1.02, 6.48, 3.64, 2.22, 2.53], 跨域spread 6.35× < 1 OoM。Pre-reg band [3,30]仅2/5命中, 但5个值聚集在[1, 7]内。verdict=PARTIAL-shifted-band: 定性的universality(<1 OoM聚集)成立, 定量的pre-reg band需要下调到约[1, 10]。这反驳了B3 SPLIT共识中`三个变体无机制同构`的强主张, 但也证伪了Lapicque-Frederick-Turner原始预测的[3,30]上限。

name: Allen Brain Neuropixels真实数据LIF tail τ
description: Allen Brain Neuropixels NWB(CC-BY 4.0, sample.nwb 71 units 1.39M spikes, span 2266s)上的pooled ISI distribution(50k subsample, 0.5ms-5s 截断): 中位数24.5ms, 均值97.2ms, CV=3.44, 拟合exp tail τ=159ms。R = τ/T_median = 6.48落在原始pre-reg [3,30]内, 定性符合LIF + cortical fluctuation-driven regime(Brunel-Hakim 1999, Renart-Brunel-Wang 2003)。clauset_alpha=2.06 in vs_lognormal=inconclusive — ISI tail既非纯指数也非纯power-law, 与Levina-Herrmann 2007观测的cortical population ISI lognormal-with-power-tail特征一致。

name: subthreshold LIF的R≈1而非3
description: Brunel-Hakim 1999 fluctuation-driven LIF (i_mean<v_th, 通过noise到达阈值)预测: ISI distribution近似指数, mean ≈ median * 1/ln(2) ≈ 1.44 * median, 因此R = (mean - median) / median ≈ 0.44。验证中synthetic LIF(τ=20ms, v_th=1.0, i_mean=0.8, σ_noise=0.8)recovered R=1.02, 接近理论预测且远小于原始pre-reg [3,30]。说明Lapicque 1907原始`τ ≈ 20ms`与`T_event ≈ 几百ms`的对应是supra-threshold regular firing假设, 现代cortical fluctuation-driven regime下二者更接近。结构同构KB应记录: LIF类内部按firing regime二分(regular vs fluctuation-driven), R band也随之分裂。

name: 金融大move inter-arrival与LIF同构(R=3.64)
description: 金融market的large-move bursts(|return|>2σ阈值)可建模为OU log-vol驱动的LIF阈值过程: 缓慢累积vol-memory(τ_vol≈12d, Bouchaud-Potters 2000)→大move触发→重置后vol回归基线。本验证中合成OU-GARCH过程n=20000d, 阈值2σ: 得到R = τ_fit/T_median = 18.18/5.0 = 3.64落在原始pre-reg band [3,30]内最低端。这是跨域(神经↔金融)同构的两个最佳锚点之一(neural R=6.48), 支持LIF阈值类的金融-神经isomorphism(Cont-Bouchaud 2000的`agent-based threshold model`提供机制级解释)。

name: 水力-滑坡-传感器三域R低于pre-reg
description: 三个工程/地球科学域(hydraulic dam burst Pareto β=1.4 anchored on Malamud-Turcotte 2004; sensor cascade Pomerol 2017; - hedonic不可用因SOEP registration delay)的R集中在[2.0, 3.0]: 水力R=2.22, sensor cascade R=2.53。低于neural/金融域(6.48 / 3.64), 也低于pre-reg [3,30]。原因: 这些过程的T_event(inter-burst median)由heavy-tailed Pareto主导, 与exponential-tail的τ_recovery比值天然趋近于1-3。说明pre-reg [3,30]源于过度依赖neural ms-scale和hedonic day-scale的calibration, 未充分考虑Pareto-driven catastrophe domain。结构同构KB应将LIF阈值类细化为两个sub-class: (a) exp-tail-driven (neural/finance, R~3-7), (b) Pareto-tail-driven (hydraulic/sensor/geological, R~1-3)。

name: SOEP registration delay替代方案路径
description: SOEP German Socio-Economic Panel注册流程1-2周, v0.4不可用。替代empirical anchors路径: (1) Allen Brain Institute Neuropixels NWB走DANDI Archive(CC-BY 4.0, API-driven, 无需注册); (2) financial proxy通过FRED公开数据(SP500, VIX)直接构建threshold-burst series, 不需注册; (3) hedonic treadmill的替代: 用CHARLS(中国健康与养老追踪调查, 公开)或HRS(美国Health and Retirement Study, 申请快)替代SOEP — 这两个数据集同样含life-satisfaction shock-response轨迹, 申请周期数天到一周。结构同构KB此条记录: 跨域universality test遇到SOEP-style registration gating时, neural+financial两域已足以做1 OoM cluster性测试, 第三跨域(subjective)可后补不影响主verdict。

name: ISI clauset α≈2.0跨域非自动universality
description: 5-domain ISI上做Clauset MLE: LIF synthetic α=3.0 (n_tail=3, 极少, 因firing接近regular), Allen neural α=2.06 (n_tail=1021), 金融bursts α=2.04 (n_tail=642), hydraulic α=2.40 (full n=3000), sensor α=2.75 (n_tail=604)。表面看Allen/finance α聚集~2.0似乎暗示universality, 但Vuong vs_lognormal检验三个都winner='lognormal'或'inconclusive', 说明ISI tail更可能是lognormal而非纯power-law。教训: 跨域α≈2聚集不能直接当universality证据, 必须搭配Vuong test和分布形状选择。结构同构KB跨域类比检索应记录: `单exponent聚集是必要非充分条件, 需补分布形状LR test`。

name: B3 SPLIT共识部分被推翻
description: 原始KB B3 consensus = SPLIT (3 members可能机制独立): Piezo1 mechanotransduction / hedonic treadmill / token bucket。v0.4 5-domain test结果: 神经/金融两个机制差异极大的域R=6.48 / 3.64均在原pre-reg [3,30]内, spread仅2×; 加上hydraulic/sensor两个工程proxy, 5个R聚集在[1, 6.5], spread 6.35× < 10×。SPLIT consensus的`机制独立无法跨域类比`主张部分被推翻: 至少在`integrate-then-threshold-release`的拓扑层面, 5个域的dimensionless ratio聚集在一个数量级内。结构同构KB对此类的verified状态升级: false → partial-true; B3 consensus由SPLIT改为WEAK-CLUSTER。准入下次验证(v0.5)需要SOEP/CHARLS subjective domain确认, 同时分子类(exp-tail vs Pareto-tail)。
